requirements.requirement: T-HUFF (a) and L-CANON restricted to non-oversubscribed `ℓ`; (b) universal; oversubscribed construction rejected before any lookup.
T-INFL requires a fresh cursor; T-SEG states `concat()` preservation, cursor range, end behaviour and representable domains; L-SEG-PNG obliges each PNG reader to supply them.

T-SEG's cost and termination contract and T12's separate `seg_steps ≤ C_SEG·(seg_count() + 1)` charge, discharged in PNG at 12 container bytes per segment. Completed after the focused re-review (finding 1): the counters `core_steps` and `seg_steps` are disjoint, T12's `|Z|`-linear inequality bounds `core_steps` only, and total work is their sum (Step accounting).

`png_oracle.py` tracks fdAT presence (`fdat_seen`) apart from payload length, as `policy_oracle.py`'s `parts_seen` did; vectors `apng/empty-fdat-payload` (still: the default image; frames: frame 0, then `TruncatedZlib`) and `apng/empty-fdat-then-data`, each with a `-still` variant; SPEC P14.1 says "fdAT chunk". The pre-fix oracle fails the first pair (`MissingFrameData`) and passes the second.
Requests use `R_p`, `N_p` from the header prefix `MH(b)` (Notation); the profiled request rows are held out of Stage 1.
Freeze procedure redesigned around a permitted cap envelope (`REVIEW-BRIEF.md`, `limits-draft/LIMITS.md`); Stage 1 hashes no cap value.
`check_vectors.py`'s `zlib_streams` yields `Z = []` for an existing empty IDAT run or empty-payload fdAT frame; the gate `zlib/empty-idat-only` inflates `Z = []`.
L-HDR-BITS's supporting argument replaced by the aggregate coding-cost argument.
P-BRIDGE and P-R describe the Python evidence as the pixel and `recovered` comparison it is and list the missing observations.
Drop the Adler-32 comparison: `zlib/bad-adler`, T-INFL.
Write the first byte of a match crossing the limit before the limit check, or report `Full` at byte `L` instead of `L + 1`: `deflate/match-overruns-image-is-excess`, L-LIMIT.
Read the bit position into a `u32`: lesson 4; T-SEG's 64-bit statement (the verifier rejects the narrowing at `8·MAX_INPUT`).
Skip the CRC of ancillary chunks: `container/ancillary-crc`, T6.
Accept PLTE after IDAT in a truecolour image: `plte/after-idat-rgb`, T6.
Allow a second gAMA: `order/gAMA-duplicate`, T6.
Skip the CRC check of the first chunk: `container/ihdr-crc`, T2.

Compute `4·W·H` in `u32`: the verifier's overflow obligation (T1) and `area_cap_u64`; no vector wraps (`ihdr/width-2^31-1-output` wraps to a value still above `MAX_OUTPUT`), so this kill is verifier-only.
Change `|b| > MAX_INPUT` to `≥`: L1, L2, T2, `limits/exact-max-input-trailing` (D18).
Paeth with `pb < pc` instead of `≤`: `filter/4-ct2-d8`, `paeth_ties`, T-FILT.
